entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer available as a managed cloud or Apache-2.0 self-hosted OSS. It supports multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states through temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval.

entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This official Hermes Agent memory provider utilizes the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing and tiered L0/L1/L2 loading. It is an AGPL-3.0 open-source context database that provides observable retrieval with directory-browsing trajectories.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This brain for the Hermes Agent provides synthesis and gap analysis for queries. It supports multi-user scoping via login and creates typed edges without requiring LLM calls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system supports long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents and is accessible via Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a context tree using git-like version control via brv vc commit, branch, and merge. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system that uses a single SQLite database to achieve sub-millisecond performance. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and provides a Python SDK for direct memory operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes vector search, structured facts, fabric recall, and an auto-curated wiki. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context using local infrastructure like Qdrant and Redis.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets. It supports multiple agent providers, including Pi and MCP clients, and includes CLI tools for task investigation.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This lossless context management plugin uses a SQLite-backed message store and a hierarchical DAG to build depth-aware summary nodes. It provides agent tools for searching and expanding compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for the Hermes Agent. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Provides a local-first identity, memory, and secrets layer that enables portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and MCP clients. It features source-backed recall and repairable memory, achieving a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Acts as a shared memory layer for multi-agent systems using an open engram YAML format. It stores memory as plain-text YAML and offers local-first, zero-cost search for Hermes and Cursor.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: Serves as an on-device memory and context engine that operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It utilizes hybrid retrieval via BM25 and vector search and integrates through MCP and Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: Optimizes context for Long Context LLM Inference through block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. This reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and offers native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Offers a durable, file-based long-term memory architecture using SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases. It is distributed as a five-package plugin family including a Hermes adapter and an MCP server.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: A self-maintaining Hermes memory plugin that provides explainable recall via why_retrieved tags. It includes built-in contradiction tracking, recency ranking, and owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses local-first SQLite-vec storage and functions as an MCP-native server with automated configuration.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide evidence packets per query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Provides reflective memory using semantic search with BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for codebases and multimedia with OCR support and uses edge tags for bidirectional relationships.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Enables long-term, cross-project memory by storing data as inspectable Markdown files. This daemonless approach uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: A memory and context layer that resolves live workspace state into verified facts to reduce prompt tokens. It operates locally without hosted services and exposes context as an MCP server.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Reduces tool-schema overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 through local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dashboard to track estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to manage memories. It features importance-weighted recall via a 1-10 ranking system, BM25 keyword search, and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory system that supports real, immediate event deletion. It includes an on-demand summarizer and provides an audit trace of all memory operations via a trace.jsonl log.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage state updates and searches.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables API charging for AI agents using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to facilitate payments across various blockchain networks.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, alongside configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both embedded and multi-mode execution via Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon. It offers dense HNSW ANN, sparse and exact-text recall, and MinHash deduplication.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides five native tools for managing and searching local artifacts. It supports an opt-in process for automatic tool-OKF generation and includes a proactive router skill for agent integration.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It employs a hybrid search approach combining vector, graph, and BM25 methods, and features automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories via semantic and literal code search. It runs on localhost and supports grounded Q&A featuring file-and-line citations.
